title: Automated intake of multi-page drawing sets
question: Is automatic splitting of multi-page PDFs, with an agent creating the hierarchy and assigning pages, in scope? If so, what does the agent output and how are its mistakes reviewed?
context: The PDF processing PRD asks for it (DSGN-REQ-034) but leaves the output format and error reporting open. Nothing implementing it was found. The web supports manual page preview, crop and rotate (DSGN-REQ-033).
